admission.justification: The shared line, its authority copy, the recovery detail and the size budget must agree, so one statement keeps every seat told the same way to declare a wait.

applicability: The always-on wait line that every role capsule receives and its recovery detail.
conditions: The line is composed from core/authority.md into each capsule.
exclusions: Role-specific wait rules, which live in their own texts.

evidence: sync-skills --check; capsule budget tests; packet v8 named core/invariants.md, but the line's source is core/authority.md

statement: The always-on wait line tells every seat, on any harness, how to declare a helper wait or a background wait (each process, pid or log, expected end, check in N minutes 1-30, default 3), that a harness wake continues its own work, and names role_message on agents-remember-task in the no-progress-message rule; its source is core/authority.md (AU10.3), and core/authority.md:100 counts a declared background wait as not silent; the recovery detail counts either declared wait as a wait.
